STRUCT.name: ReadbackRequestDTO
STRUCT.MATH: 8 + 4 + 4 = 16 bytes. Size is divisible by 16. Editor validator checks row stride 16 and temp NativeArray base pointer modulo 16 equals 0; no Pack=1 risk.

STRUCT.name: AsyncBuoyancyWaveParametersDTO
STRUCT.MATH: 16 * 4 = 64 bytes, one L1 cache line and shader-structured-buffer row.

STRUCT.name: AsyncReadbackCounterDTO
STRUCT.MATH: Counter lanes occupy exactly 64 bytes; concurrent high-frequency counter row does not share a cache line with another counter row.

SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: GlobalQualityWeight is continuous. Sample budget uses q*q*(3-2q) to move from minimum hull corners to maximum hull grid; smoothing alpha and dead-reckoning decay are lerped. Below 0.3 the path collapses toward 4 samples and a cheap triangle-wave mock/fallback, reducing readback bytes from 2048 at 128 samples to 64 at 4 samples. Apply job lanes are bounded by actual max(dispatchCount, completedCount), and empty frames return the inbound dispatcher handle without scheduling a tiny job. The wake/shoreline path remains a bounded one-tap shader sample per requested point and automatically collapses with sample count. Above 0.7 it increases samples and wave lanes, spending saved CPU stall time on richer shader-side water rather than deterministic state bloat.

POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.RULE: Runtime does not call JobHandle.Complete inside the readback path; handles are returned to SystemDispatcher.
Scheduled job output buffers are held under Vault writer locks until PostSimulation releases them in the dispatcher completion window.
ApplyDelayedBuoyancyReadbackJob is skipped when no samples are active; the deleted RecordReadbackTelemetryJob is absent from source.

COMPILE_GUARD.RULE: Runtime files are isolated in Assets/_Project/Scripts/Physics/Buoyancy/AsyncReadback under Hecton8.Physics.Buoyancy.Runtime.asmdef.

Hecton8.Physics.Buoyancy.Runtime references Hecton8.Core, Hecton8.Core.Contracts, Hecton8.Core.Memory, Unity.Mathematics, Unity.Burst, Unity.Collections, and Unity.Jobs only; no sibling domain runtime assembly is referenced.
Hecton8.Physics.Buoyancy.Editor references the runtime assembly for proof tooling; no root Buoyancy asmdef was added because it would capture neighboring agents' files.
No Hecton8.Atmosphere using or concrete runtime type remains in AsyncBuoyancyReadbackRuntime.
Runtime route uses local Physics DTOs plus Core/Core.Memory dispatcher and Vault APIs.
Owned runtime uses TryReadHandle for pure reads, TryAcquireWriteLock for direct writes, and no TryResolveHandle calls remain in the file.
GPU uploads use private LockBufferForWrite helpers; no internal GraphicsBufferUploadUtility dependency remains.
Owned async runtime/job/contract files contain no Unity Time reads; simulation delta and readback/mock time accumulation are dispatcher-fixed-delta owned.
Wake displacement is consumed through shader globals _H8OceanWakeDisplacement and _H8OceanShorelineDepthParams, not through a sibling renderer assembly reference.
Origin AUP is cached through IOriginShiftListener; hot PreSimulation does not call HectonFloatingOrigin.CurrentTotalOffsetDouble or poll GlobalRegistry.

GPU_RING_AND_WAKE_PROJECTION.RULE: Request buffers and wave-parameter buffers are slot-matched three-ring GraphicsBuffers. Per-slot wave hashes/counts prevent overwriting wave data still consumed by pending GPU dispatches.
Runtime writes camera AUP modulo wake texture world size to _H8OceanCameraAupLocalProjection.xy; compute samples wake at request.LocalXZ + cameraProjection for origin-stable wake UV.

Ready AsyncGPUReadbackRequest slots are not cleared until completed-results Vault write lock acquisition and payload copy succeed, so transient writer contention retries instead of silently dropping data.
